_: Copy to the root of your project as deep-smoke.config.json and delete what you do not need. Every key is optional. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored, so they can be used for comments.
_baseUrl: Where the app is running. Override per run with --url.
_routes: Seed routes. Link discovery expands this at levels 2 and 3, but anything reachable only through a button, a form or a redirect has to be listed here.
_ignoreRoutes: Never visit these. A trailing star matches a subtree. Sign-out belongs here: crawling it would end the session halfway through the run.
_personas: A path, or an inline array. Omit it entirely to crawl as a single anonymous visitor.
_protectedPrefixes: Level 3 rule: an anonymous visitor must be redirected away from these.
_publicRoutes: Level 3 rule: a signed-in visitor must not be redirected away from these.
_budgets: Per persona. Level 3 rejects evidence from a run that hit either limit, because a truncated crawl is not a crawl of the whole tree.
_readySelector: A selector that only exists once your app has finished its first render. Worth setting on a slow app: it makes every visit both faster and more reliable than a fixed delay.
_retryFailedRoutes: Visit a failing route once more on a fresh page. Only a failure that reproduces is reported.
_errorBoundary: The selector is the reliable signal. Add data-error-boundary to your own fallback component and the text matching stops mattering.

console._failPatterns: Leave failPatterns unset to use the built-in list of messages that mean a page is broken. Set it to [] to fail on every console error at the chosen severity, which is strict but honest on a codebase that has no console noise.

_freshness: behaviourPaths decides when old evidence stops counting: a change under any of these invalidates it. maxAgeMinutes is only used when the crawl ran outside version control.
